supersedes.reason: The original integration record predated later immutable review-fix attachments for T02 and T03. This record binds their current canonical bytes and requalifies the integrated slice after the capability security review.

outcome: Every task can invoke consistent, composable verification profiles locally and in CI, with fail-closed supply-chain policy and immutable current evidence bindings.

integrationChecks.result: At exact clean commit 2ffbdee, the composed security-local profile passed in 282.6 seconds with 144 foundation tests, 20 security tests, 38 packages, 37 normalized findings, and zero blockers.
At the same exact clean commit, the 23-command desktop profile passed in 404.32 seconds with 144 foundation tests and 15 desktop tests.
All 14 lifecycle tests passed, including the regression allowing a paused capability-review remediation to resume after every slice is already approved while rejecting other no-slice resumptions.
The authoritative 20-capability, 117-slice, 356-task, 12-gate ledger and both generated planning views validate exactly.

reviewFixes: The current T02 and T03 review-fix evidence SHA-256 values replace the stale pre-remediation values without modifying the original integration record.

License handling now rejects OR, WITH, symbolic operators, parentheses, and mixed or malformed compound expressions before permissive category fallback; strict AND is accepted only when every component is individually allowlisted.
The capability campaign can be resumed through taskctl for an independently requested capability-level remediation after all slices are approved; the gate remains state- and reviewer-bound.

residualLimitations: Hosted GitHub Actions execution remains unverified until a remote push is separately authorized; the pinned workflow contract and every local hosted-command equivalent pass.
